# Bst-Table

> A headless React data grid: a TanStack Table v9 engine with swappable Material UI and shadcn/Radix skins. MIT/Apache only — no per-seat licensing. Pass data + columns for sorting, search, pagination and column controls out of the box; opt into editing, selection, clipboard and export with per-instance flags.

This is the AI-readable index. Full plain-text docs: https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/llms-full.txt

## Cell Types

- [Cell Types](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types): A column's renderer + editor is chosen by meta.type. 17 built-in types ship, all dependency-free inline SVG, extensible via the cell-type registry.
- [action](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/action): inline Edit / Save / Copy / Delete buttons.
- [actionMenu](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/actionMenu): compact ⋯ kebab → actions popup.
- [barcode](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/barcode): inline-SVG Code 128.
- [boolean](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/boolean): check ✓ / muted dash.
- [dateTime](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/dateTime): date / time / datetime.
- [files](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/files): image thumbnail / PDF thumbnail (pdfThumbnail) / icon + name · click to preview (image inline, PDF native viewer).
- [hyperlink](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/hyperlink): anchor.
- [kpi](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/kpi): value + trend delta chip + mini-spark.
- [longText](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/longText): clamped multi-line text.
- [multiSelect](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/multiSelect): chips + +N more overflow.
- [number](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/number): locale number / currency / percent.
- [qr](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/qr): inline-SVG QR code (byte mode, v1–10).
- [radio](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/radio): badge.
- [richText](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/richText): sanitized-HTML preview or formatted.
- [singleSelect](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/singleSelect): badge (color · icon · avatar).
- [sparkline](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/sparkline): inline SVG line / area / bar.
- [text](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/cell-types/text): single-line text, ellipsis + title tooltip.

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api): Every public export of @bloomskill/table-engine (262 symbols), with signatures read from the built .d.ts — so they match what the compiler accepts.
- [Constants](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api/constants): Exported constants and registries.
- [Functions](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api/functions): Standalone helpers and factories.
- [Hooks](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api/hooks): React hooks — the engine entry points.
- [Interfaces](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api/interfaces): Option bags, props and shape contracts.
- [Other](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api/other): Everything else.
- [Types](https://gitofkumarsathish.github.io/bst-grid/docs/api/types): Type aliases and unions.
